svg.aria-label: codex-staff exposes Codex CLI as a background worker through persona skills and ordinary companion commands. The host agent (Claude Code or Pi) delegates a task, receives a job ID, and waits for it in the background while it keeps working; only an explicit user progress question triggers a bounded snapshot of at most 8 KiB with up to five recent tools. The worker drains the codex exec --json event stream, writes events and progress files, and saves a final report that wait prints. An expiring wait exits with code 2 and leaves execution running. The worker enforces a separate deadline, 60 minutes by default and 120 at most, and 2 minutes for ask.
svg.text: 01 · AGENT LOOP· host turns over time →
02 · CODEX-STAFF· skills guide the agent; companion commands manage the job
Expiring wait: exit 2, the job keeps running; wait again.
03 · BACKGROUND JOB· runs independently of agent turns
Worker deadline: 60m default, 120m max (ask: 2m). Wait expiry leaves it running; cancel <id> stops the job.
